$comment: Barb's settings on a RecursicaChat 2.0 server that belong to the agent, the same on every stack. circlechat/rc-sync.sh sets them through the server's API, with the instructions in portable/recursicachat/agents/barb/INSTRUCTIONS.md, built from SKILL.recursicachat.md and platform/recursicachat.md. The model and the monthly budget belong to the stack: agents.barb.recursicachat in the stack's site.json, where the model is a route.
$autonomyComment: ask: Barb asks before each action that is not a read. A chat reply of hers has one tool, propose_plan, for posting a plan, and she writes nothing anywhere, so a question before any other action means a turn went outside her work.
$sandboxComment: docker: each turn runs in a container, never on the server itself. Barb needs no command in it.
$startersComment: The suggestions an empty chat with Barb shows. A starter with [placeholders] opens a fill-in dialog, one field per placeholder. The first two are her review message, with the mention, so they read the same in a direct message and in a channel.
